method: Full source and commentary read in sequential batches; individual legal comparison by second process, supplemented by mechanical wording/completeness checks. Hashes identify reviewed texts; they do not themselves establish legal correctness.

Art. 129–145a: Deliktsstatute, Mehrpersonenverhältnisse, Abtretung und Titel
